brief: A macOS menu-bar companion for Dota 2: locks the cursor, blocks Mac shortcuts and remaps modifier keys. For Mac players who remember DotA 1. It should feel nostalgic and native to the Mac.
criteria: Success: keeps the Necronomicon and ⌘, reads at 16 px in the menu bar, works in one colour, and stays clear of Valve's shield.

concepts.name: Tome of Command
concepts.idea: The DotA 1 Necronomicon, its cover sigil swapped for ⌘: your old item, bound to Mac keys.
rationale: Keeps both pieces of equity: the tilted tome and the ⌘
Flat mark for the menu bar; a detailed from-below tome for the app icon
Dota red and gold, on Mac-dark ink

recommendation: Tome of Command: flat mark in the menu bar, detailed tome as the app icon.
next_steps: Commit the kit and the new menu-bar icon
Trademark/reverse-image check before any public release
